parameters.query: SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload,admin_id,monitor_update($1::jsonb) AS monitoring,visitor_update($1::jsonb) AS visitor FROM app_settings WHERE id=true;
SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(($2::jsonb->>'handled')::boolean,false) THEN $2::jsonb->'result' ELSE handle_command($1::jsonb) END AS result;
